rows.grounds: compound describing a liṅga joined with iron of one-third part
compound naming the meaning of a hanging thread
compound describing something joined with sight

items.question: How is the liṅga distinguished by iron proportion hanging thread and sight?
premises: Iron joins one-third part of liṅga.
items.inference: Thus the liṅga is marked by these three features.
uncertainties: Exact doctrinal referent of hanging thread remains unclear.
items.plain_english: The liṅga is joined with iron of one-third part, has the meaning of a hanging thread, and is joined with sight.
